description: This file defines the 'Project' class in Dart, representing a project entity within the application's domain. It includes properties such as id, name, color, sortOrder, createdAt, and updatedAt, along with methods for copying, JSON serialization/deserialization, and handling Firestore Timestamp conversion.

classes.name: Project
classes.description: An immutable class representing a project with properties like id, name, color, order, and timestamps, including methods for cloning and JSON serialization.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Project instance with optional new values for its fields.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a Project instance from a JSON map, requiring the document ID.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Project instance into a JSON map suitable for Firestore storage.
